text: Practice set for railway aptitude exams. A train leaves Pune at 9:40 and travels 312 kilometres at an average speed of 78 kilometres per hour. At what time does it reach its destination? It takes four hours, so it arrives at 13:40. Try the next problem on your own before checking the solution.

Forum thread: Why does the Rust borrow checker reject a program that holds a mutable reference to a vector while iterating over the same vector with an immutable reference? Top answer: because aliasing a mutable borrow with a shared borrow could invalidate the iterator when the vector reallocates. Upvoted 412 times.

Study notes. In a hash table that uses linear probing, what happens to lookup speed as the load factor approaches one, and why do primary clusters appear? Probe sequences grow long since occupied slots form contiguous runs that new keys extend, so expected lookups explode near full load. Compare with chaining in the next section.

Travel guide. Many visitors assume Sydney is the national capital, yet the seat of government is Canberra. The city was designed from scratch as a compromise because neither Sydney nor Melbourne would accept the other as capital of Australia.

Botany lecture summary. Under heat and drought, C4 species outperform C3 species because they pump carbon dioxide into bundle sheath cells, concentrating it around RuBisCO. This limits photorespiration even when stomata shut to conserve water, making carbon fixation more efficient.

Pharmacology bulletin on macrolide interactions. Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and raises the INR, so the INR should be checked within three to five days of starting the antibiotic. Similar concerns apply to statins such as simvastatin, where the dose may need to be paused.

messages.content: You are a helpful SQL tutor.
Write a SQL query that returns the second highest salary from an employees table, returning NULL when there is no second distinct salary.
SELECT MAX(salary) FROM employees WHERE salary < (SELECT MAX(salary) FROM employees);

text: Statistics primer. Hypothesis tests compare samples against a null distribution. The two sample t test compares means, while rank based tests such as Mann Whitney compare medians without assuming normality. Always check the assumptions before reporting a p value.

Networking basics. TCP uses a sliding window for flow control and a three way handshake to establish connections. Slow start doubles the window every round trip until a threshold is reached, after which congestion avoidance grows it linearly.

Biology review. DNA replication is semi conservative. Primase lays down RNA primers, DNA polymerase extends them in the five prime to three prime direction, and ligase joins Okazaki fragments on the lagging strand.

Data structures digest. A skip list keeps several layers of linked lists so search takes logarithmic expected time. Cuckoo hashing uses two tables and relocates keys on collision, giving constant worst case lookups.

messages.content: How do I reverse a linked list in Python?
Walk the list keeping prev, current and next pointers, and point each node back at prev before advancing. Return prev at the end.

text: Cooking notes. Toast cumin and coriander seeds in a dry pan until fragrant, grind them, then bloom the powder in hot oil with ginger and garlic before adding tomatoes and simmering the lentils for twenty minutes.
Geography quiz answers. The capital of Peru is Lima. The capital of Chile is Santiago. The capital of Kenya is Nairobi. The capital of Canada is Ottawa.
